Domain proofs between report samples (dynamic_domain) for rates, outputs, state checks; proofs move to napkin/program; unsure front or engine.

Roundoff at bounds in dense reads, bound violations that stop a run, cash-control integrals across a kink; closed forms.
Decision resolver (used by napkin/session.py): read-only boundary, live answers equal saved replay; pause point open; imports two test modules.
Quantiles, medians and moments of napkin/distributions.py against mpmath oracles; no sampling and no model.
Deep: a million draws against the cdf and Latin means need no model; the third test studies a catalogue scenario.
erf of the expression core against mpmath; four tests need no model; the fifth integrates a tally from source.

Zero and positive faces, crossings with clocks, repayment legs, face proofs; closed forms; needs events; one test pins file order.
A stock that empties and refills by events: exact faces, boundary roundoff corrections, pass-through queues, face proofs; closed forms.
A draw at each firing (median in the central run, a stream per sample) and delayed(x, D); becomes explicit .draw().
highs.solve equals SciPy linprog bit for bit, with one optimum from linear-program theory; no model.
Rules of the old `event start` at build and at t=0; the spec has no start: unsure, may be DELETE.
Events due at one moment go in the order of their lines; the rounds of the new moment replace this.
Triggers on a quantity that only rises or falls fire at the closed-form decay time; a mixed direction is refused.
Monte Carlo studies: each sample equals its closed form; seeds, Latin and Sobol bounds, remote samples; reads no catalogue.
Options, runs and the levels of an edit document, mostly through studies, with a closed form; last test: old events.
Options, runs and edit precedence through the Runs table and direct runs; closed-form totals; reads no catalogue.

Repeated crossing at 2, 4, 6, 8 h, rearmed by a state. Unsure: old idiom; trigger resets keep the behaviour.
Version strings and schema versions agree. No model: reads only the library JSON; imports tests.helpers for ROOT.
Report of runs: one sample per instant, units, lags and peaks in closed form, unestimated outputs. Output settings go.
Step cap from `resolution` and timescales; logistic closed form over 20 years. Numerics stay; the control's spelling is open.
Five roundoff arguments at bounds and exact event times, by exact fractions. Kept numerics; moves and timers need S4.
Evidence trail of a run: exercised or possible. Consumer; two tests rest on parts left out per start options.
Closed-form oracles of the general run: decay, faces, shares, coupled flows, moves, budgets. Spans S0-S4; same-moment order cases go.
Uniform numbers of a study: streams, seeds, latin and Sobol strata. No engine run, no language.
Decision windows at a pause, over named calls and file order. Unsure: the pause stays, its same-time rule changes.
Size and tolerance of each value by the documented rule, and a closed-form drain. Engine numerics that stay.
Conformance of the solver adapters against closed-form problems. No language; the module stays.
Rate that tests a ledger at its bound when a segment starts; closed form. Needs one timed switch.
Switching surfaces of min, max, clip, abs and comparisons, by rule; a segment ends at a closed-form kink.
Timeline engine on table models, closed forms, both tiers. Derivative (B0), flat-parity, window, while cases go; one reads examples/.
Bound written as an expression of inputs, in a table model; closed-form levels. Third test is of Plan.flat.
Report and class of whole-run derivatives (derivatives.py, influence.py, smooth.py). Removed now with the code.
Solver steps longer than the cap in a table block: crossings, pulses, bounds; closed forms. Kept Solution code.
Run with given chance outcomes, kept firings, shares by exact fractions. Unsure: old outcome form; one derivative test (B0).

Pairwise sum tree against math.fsum and its error bound. No language; sum trees stay.
